title: Galaxy clusters at z ∼ 1 imaged by ALMA with the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
question: Reveal the thermodynamic structure (pressure, temperature, density, entropy, cooling time) of two z~1 galaxy clusters, RCS J2319+0038 and HSC J0947-0119, from high-resolution ALMA Band 3 SZE images combined with Chandra, HSC and ACT data, including whether they host cool cores

data.angular_resolution: all baselines: beam 3.76 x 3.38 arcsec PA 82.5 deg (RCS J2319+0038), 3.77 x 3.22 arcsec PA -89.1 deg (HSC J0947-0119); 12-m only 3.60 x 3.25 and 3.63 x 3.11 arcsec; 7-m only 18.7 x 11.9 and 17.8 x 11.2 arcsec
data.sensitivity: average 1 sigma noise 4.8 uJy/beam (RCS J2319+0038) and 5.0 uJy/beam (HSC J0947-0119) for all baselines; 5.8 and 5.9 uJy/beam after smoothing to 5'' FWHM

recipe.goal: Detect and subtract compact millimeter sources
recipe.method: Fit compact sources in the uv plane with uvmodelfit using only baselines longer than 15 klambda, all channels fitted together excluding line-affected ranges; subtract sources detected above 5 sigma from the whole visibility data

recipe.goal: Image the SZE and estimate noise
recipe.method: Multi-Scale CLEAN with tclean in joint mosaic imaging of 12-m and 7-m data; noise measured on difference maps from time-split visibilities; images smoothed to 5'' for display
key_parameters: mask radius 50'', threshold 0.01 mJy, scales [0,4,8,16,32,64]'', natural weighting, 0.5'' pixels

recipe.method: Elliptical Gaussian fit to the unsmoothed ALMA image with imfit; elliptical beta model fit to the unsmoothed Chandra image with Sherpa beta2d; integrated SZE flux within 45''
key_parameters: Gaussian free parameters: center, major and minor axis FWHM, position angle; beta model parameters x0, y0, S0, beta, theta_c, q, psi
assumptions: constant noise within 50'' of field centre for error estimates (Condon97)

recipe.goal: Measure mean X-ray temperature and luminosity
recipe.method: Fit the 0.4-7.0 keV Chandra spectrum within 45'' of the cluster centre with XSPEC; spectral analysis of Chandra data processed with CIAO 4.13
key_parameters: energy band 0.4-7.0 keV; background from region theta > 3.2'
assumptions: collisional ionization equilibrium, metal abundance 0.3 solar (Anders89), z=0.90, N_H=4.2e20 cm^-2 (HI4PI16), helium mass fraction Y=0.25

recipe.method: CAMIRA richness and galaxy density from HSC-SSP; weak-lensing shear with re-Gaussianization, background selection, NFW fit to tangential shear
key_parameters: surface mass density smoothed by a 30'' FWHM Gaussian for S/N peaks
assumptions: NFW profile with concentration tied to mass by Diemer15

recipe.goal: Imaging simulations and missing flux correction
recipe.method: Build model y maps, create SZE input images in four spectral windows, simulate ALMA visibilities with simobserve (10 noise seeds), deconvolve as for real data, and fit I_out = c1 I_in + c0 binned by input intensity; apply c1 to intensity differences relative to a reference radius
key_parameters: reference radius theta_bar = 35'' from the cluster centre
y_peak = 1.1e-4 (RCS J2319+0038) and 1.5e-4 (HSC J0947-0119), with doubled and halved cases
assumptions: RCS J2319+0038 gas isothermal at 5.90 keV with triaxial elliptical beta density, h70/eta=1; HSC J0947-0119 McDonald14b pressure profile, kT=9.4 keV, h70=1, eta=1

recipe.goal: Reconstruct y profile and fit pressure-profile models
recipe.method: Average observed intensity in elliptical bins, apply missing-flux correction relative to the 7th bin, add systematics in quadrature, compare with isothermal beta model and generalized NFW profiles, fit M500 and h70/eta by chi-square
key_parameters: bins geometrically spaced, inner-most 0<theta<4'', width increasing by a factor of 1.1; reference bin centered at 34.4''
relativistic correction c_rel between 0.94 and 0.98 at 92 GHz for 3<kT<10 keV applied to model predictions, not data
assumptions: h70=1 and eta=1 in the presented results; axis ratio and position angle fixed to best-fit values

recipe.goal: Joint SZE plus X-ray deprojection to temperature, density, entropy and cooling time
recipe.method: Fit SZE (theta_bar<30'') and 0.4-7 keV X-ray (theta_bar<60'') elliptical-annulus brightness jointly, varying temperature and density per ellipsoidal shell; compute K and t_cool
key_parameters: bin size 10'' in elliptical annuli, reference bin centered at 35''; temperature beyond 30'' fixed at 5.90 keV
Lambda_bol from rest-frame emissivity integrated from 0.1 eV to 1 MeV
assumptions: ellipsoidal shells with same orientation as triaxial beta model; h70/eta=1

recipe.goal: Test the origin of the ACT SZE centroid offset
recipe.method: Cluster-injection simulations in the real ACT map with model cluster and compact sources, re-running filtering and detection, plus comparison with Hilton21 position recovery statistics
key_parameters: spectral index -0.7 assumed for the compact-source effect on peak y (at most 4%)
